name: IBY_INSTR_CREATION_RULES
description: IBY_INSTR_CREATION_RULES specifies how payments are grouped into payment instructions. Payment instructions are always grouped by internal bank account and payment process profile but additional items stored in this table can be added for further grouping. With more grouping rules, there are likely to be more, but smaller, payment instructions. This table corresponds to the Payment Instruction Creation tab of the Update Payment Process Profile page.

columns.name: SYSTEM_PROFILE_CODE
columns.description: Unique primary key

columns.name: ORG_ID_FLAG
columns.description: Business unit flag

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for payment date.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_PAYMENT_CURRENCY
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for payment currency.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_INTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for disbursement bank account. If the processing type on the payment process profile is Printed, this flag is automatically set to Yes and cannot be overridden.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_MAX_PAYMENTS_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether there is a limit on the number of payments that can be grouped into one payment file.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUEST
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they originated in different payment process requests.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_LEGAL_ENTITY
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for legal entity.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_BILL_PAYABLE
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for bill payable.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_ORGANIZATION
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for business unit.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_MAX_INSTRUCTION_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether there is a limit on the total payment amount when payment file is created. This value is set to Yes when a value is specified in the MAX_AMOUNT_PER_INSTR_VALUE column.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for payment function.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_PAYMENT_REASON
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for payment reason.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_RFC
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for regional finance center.

columns.name: MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_INSTRUCTION
columns.description: Maximum number of payments that can be included in a payment instruction. When a value exists in this column, the Create Payment Instructions program uses it as one of its rules for building payment instructions.

columns.name: MAX_AMOUNT_PER_INSTR_VALUE
columns.description: Maximum total amount for which a payment instruction can be created. When a value exists in this column, the Create Payment Instructions program uses it as one of its rules for building payment instructions.

columns.name: MAX_AMOUNT_PER_INSTR_CURR_CODE
columns.description: Currency in which the maximum total amount per payment instruction is calculated.

columns.name: MAX_AMOUNT_FX_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type, such as corporate, spot, and daily, used to compare the payment file total amount to the maximum total amount allowed. Types are defined in the General Ledger currency exchange rate type table.

columns.name: SORT_OPTION_1
columns.description: Primary column by which payments in a payment instruction are sorted. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_SORT_OPTIONS include PAYEE_NAME, PAYEE_NUMBER, and others.

columns.name: SORT_ORDER_1
columns.description: Order in which the primary sorting occurs. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_SORT_ORDERS include ASCENDING and DESCENDING.

columns.name: SORT_OPTION_2
columns.description: Second column by which payments in a payment instruction are sorted. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_SORT_OPTIONS include PAYEE_NAME, PAYEE_NUMBER, and others.

columns.name: SORT_ORDER_2
columns.description: Order in which the secondary sorting occurs. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_SORT_ORDERS include ASCENDING and DESCENDING.

columns.name: SORT_OPTION_3
columns.description: Third column by which payments in a payment instruction are sorted. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_SORT_OPTIONS include PAYEE_NAME, PAYEE_NUMBER, and others.

columns.name: SORT_ORDER_3
columns.description: Order in which the tertiary sorting occurs. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_SORT_ORDERS include ASCENDING and DESCENDING.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_PAYMENT_METHOD
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether payments should be put into separate payment files when they have different values for payment method.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
